provenance.procedure: GET /search/tv?query=test&page=1 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 /search/tv contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb search.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB v3 /search/tv returns hits under a flat results array. The client reads only id (a NUMBER, unlike TVDB's string), name, first_air_date ("YYYY-MM-DD", sometimes empty), overview, poster_path and backdrop_path, tolerating the many other fields. poster_path/backdrop_path are path fragments ("/xyz.jpg"), verified against the real /search/tv response for a live query (2026-09-20) — the CDN base is image.tmdb.org/t/p/. The token travels in the Authorization header, never the query, so the matched path carries no secret. The second hit deliberately carries a null poster_path and no backdrop_path (a hit TMDB has no artwork for), to prove missing artwork stays empty rather than becoming a URL to a path that was never real. The third hit deliberately carries no id, to prove the client skips a hit it could not turn into a follow rather than surfacing an unfollowable row.
